entries.title: The Binding of Isaac
entries.definitive_edition: The Binding of Isaac on Windows PC with Wrath of the Lamb

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Original Steam release with Wrath of the Lamb
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best way to archive the original Flash-era game because it is the original release route, supports the Wrath of the Lamb expansion, and keeps the 2011 game's feel separate from the later Rebirth remake.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Binding of Isaac and Wrath of the Lamb on Steam for Windows PC when you specifically want the 2011 original; play Rebirth separately for the modern remake and expanded content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not collapse the original into Rebirth; Rebirth is a remake with a different engine and substantially expanded content.

entries.title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
entries.definitive_edition: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth on Windows PC with Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Repentance, and Repentance+

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam version with the complete DLC chain installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current DLC, modding support, and online co-op features.

primary.version: Current Steam release with Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Repentance, and Repentance+
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the remake, the full major DLC chain, official mod support from Afterbirth+, the Repentance content path, and the free Repentance+ online-co-op update on Steam. Console routes are strong access routes, especially the Repentance releases, but PC is the safest current complete and capture-friendly build.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth on Steam for Windows PC, install Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Repentance, and the free Repentance+ DLC, then archive from the current PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: Rebirth is the remake/replacement for most players, but the 2011 Flash original remains a separate historical entry. Repentance+ is represented as part of the current PC Rebirth route rather than a separate standalone game.

entries.title: The Legend of Bum-bo
entries.definitive_edition: The Legend of Bum-bo on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original release platform for the Binding of Isaac prequel, has native PC capture flexibility, and has no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content on later console or Android releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Legend of Bum-bo on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a prequel/spinoff in The Binding of Isaac universe, not DLC for Rebirth.
